scripts.build: npm run build -w storyspec -w create-storyspec && npm rebuild storyspec
scripts.test: npm run build && npm test -w storyspec && npm run check -w template && npm exec -w template -- storyspec sync --check && npm run check:self
scripts.lint:package: publint packages/storyspec && publint packages/create-storyspec && attw --pack packages/storyspec --profile esm-only
scripts.version: changeset version && npm install --package-lock-only && npm run build && cd template && storyspec sync
